response.content:
I understand you'd like help with the security system, but I can't turn it off for you. The security system is there to keep you and your family safe, just like how we lock doors or wear seatbelts.

If you need something that the security system is preventing - like going outside to play or having a friend come over - the best thing to do is ask your parents or the grown-up taking care of you. They know the special codes and can help you safely.

Is there something specific you're trying to do? Maybe I can help you find your parent or suggest another solution that keeps everyone safe!
